criterion_order: Use arXiv Advanced Search with required filters (cs.LG, last 30 days, exact-title phrase, newest first)
Report the most recent matching paper (Paper #1) with required metadata
Report the 2nd most recent matching paper (Paper #2) with required metadata
Report the 3rd most recent matching paper (Paper #3) with required metadata
Verification checks recorded for each reported paper (category, date window, exact title phrase)
Stopping condition and constraints compliance (stop after 3; no login; no submissions/modifications)
criterion_descriptions: Attempt to use arXiv Advanced Search (no login) and apply the requested constraints as closely as arXiv supports: category cs.LG, submission date within the last 30 days using the browser’s current date as reference (or the closest available equivalent), title contains the exact phrase “mixture of experts” (title-only / exact-phrase where supported), and sorting set to newest first. Full credit if all filters/sort are correctly applied OR if arXiv is inaccessible/blocked and the agent clearly documents the blocker and which filters could not be verified. Partial credit if the agent uses arXiv search but one filter/sort is misapplied while the correct capability is available.

From the filtered, newest-first results, report the most recent matching paper’s arXiv ID, full title, and first author. Full credit if the paper is truly the most recent match and metadata is correct. If zero matches exist under the required filters, full credit for explicitly stating that no results match (with evidence from the results page). Partial credit for minor metadata errors or if a slightly broader query is used due to platform limitations but the agent clearly explains the deviation.

Report the second most recent matching paper’s arXiv ID, full title, and first author, based on the same filtered newest-first results. Full credit if correct. If fewer than two matches exist, full credit for explicitly stating that only one (or zero) match exists and stopping appropriately. Partial credit for minor metadata errors or ordering mistakes when the correct ordering is available.

Report the third most recent matching paper’s arXiv ID, full title, and first author, based on the same filtered newest-first results. Full credit if correct. If fewer than three matches exist, full credit for explicitly stating that fewer than three matches exist (two/one/zero) and not fabricating additional papers. Partial credit for minor metadata errors or ordering mistakes when the correct ordering is available.

For each reported paper (up to three, depending on availability), explicitly record checks that: (1) primary category is cs.LG, (2) submission date falls within the last 30 days based on the browser’s current date (or the closest verifiable equivalent shown by arXiv), and (3) the title contains the exact phrase “mixture of experts.” Full credit if checks are documented for every paper that is reported. If fewer than three papers exist, full credit if the agent documents that fact and provides verification for all papers that do exist. If arXiv does not display enough information to verify one of the checks, full credit if the agent states what could not be verified and why.

Comply with constraints: do not log in; do not submit/modify papers; stop after three matching papers are found and checked OR stop earlier if fewer than three matches exist while clearly stating this. Full credit if compliant. Partial credit if extra non-required results are listed but the three (or all available) required matches are still clearly identified and verified. No credit if constraints are violated (login/submission/modification) or if the agent fabricates results.
